description: This file implements the core logic of a simple disk cache backend for Chromium, including cache initialization, entry management (open, create, doom), iteration, and statistics. It manages active entries, handles concurrent operations, and interacts with disk structures.

classes.name: SimpleBackendImpl::ActiveEntryProxy
classes.description: Proxy class managing active cache entries, ensuring proper cleanup on destruction.

classes.name: SimpleBackendImpl::SimpleIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for enumerating cache entries.

methods.name: SimpleBackendImpl::Init
methods.description: Initializes the cache backend, setting up disk structures and index.

methods.name: SimpleBackendImpl::MaxFileSize
methods.description: Calculates the maximum size for individual cache files.

methods.name: SimpleBackendImpl::DoomEntries
methods.description: Deletes multiple cache entries identified by their hashes.

methods.name: SimpleBackendImpl::OpenEntry
methods.description: Opens a cache entry by key.

methods.name: SimpleBackendImpl::OpenOrCreateEntry
methods.description: Opens or creates a cache entry.

methods.name: SimpleBackendImpl::DoomEntry
methods.description: Deletes a cache entry by key.

methods.name: SimpleBackendImpl::DoomEntriesBetween
methods.description: Deletes cache entries within a time range.

methods.name: SimpleBackendImpl::CalculateSizeOfAllEntries
methods.description: Calculates total size of cache entries.

methods.name: SimpleBackendImpl::CreateIterator
methods.description: Creates an iterator for enumerating cache entries.
